recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photograph of a human torso wrapped in thin strands of barbed wire, featuring bold, lowercase geometric typography in black, red, and white positioned along the edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp metallic texture of wire against soft organic skin
Bold flat-color typography contrasting with grainy photographic background
Vertical text alignment on the left balancing horizontal text at the top
coreInvariants: Desaturated, sepia-tinted monochrome palette for the image
Barbed wire as a central graphic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A close-up torso occupies the entire frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the barbed wire strands in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left title, moves down the vertical name on the left margin, then follows the diagonal lines of the wire across the body.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is tight and claustrophobic, using the skin as a textured canvas.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated cream and charcoal for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for primary title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant tomato red for secondary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; high saturation contrast between the red text and the muted background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors and orientations for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and lowercase proportions match the era and style.
Classic geometric sans with similar monolinear weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photograph of a human torso. The skin should have a slight yellowish/sepia tint. Wrap the torso in several strands of thin, dark barbed wire that crisscross the chest and stomach. The lighting should be harsh, creating deep shadows in the crevices of the body.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold lowercase geometric sans-serif text. Place two stacked words in the top left corner, the top word in black and the bottom word in red. Place a single line of white text vertically along the bottom-left edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the red color vibrant and flat?
Is the vertical text oriented correctly?

adjustableVariables: Tightness of the crop on the torso
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible film grain across the entire image.
Ensure the barbed wire looks sharp and metallic.
Verify the typography is perfectly flat with no shadows.
Confirm the lowercase 'a' and 'g' are geometric in style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, high-contrast monochrome subject with bold, lowercase geometric sans-serif type in a primary-color-and-black palette, using vertical and horizontal axis alignments.
